units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:15">Sot. IX, 15</cite> (<cite ref="Sotah 49b:2">49ᵇ</cite>) <he>בית הועד יהיה לז׳</he> (= <he>לבית ז׳</he>) the scholars’ meeting house shall become a place of licentiousness (where low people assemble).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:19">Num. R. s. 13</cite> <he>על ז׳ אחותו</he> for seducing his sister.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 36b:6">Ab. Zar. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>דרך ז׳</he> a meretricious connection, opp. <cite ref="A01621"><he>אִישׁוּת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 26:7">Gen. R. s. 26</cite> <he>על הכל … חוץ מן הז׳ …</he> the Lord is long-suffering to everything except debauchery.
<cite ref="Ketubot 3a:4">Keth. 3ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="B01047"><he>בְּעִילָה</he></cite>; a. v. fr.
